note: Discovery list. status: ready = the collector has a reader for it; planned = open licence confirmed, reader not built yet; needs-check = licence or download route not confirmed; not-allowed = never download. Only openly licensed, redistributable books are ever collected. Dates are when the owner-visible facts were last read by a person or by Discover-Library-Sites.bat.

sites.name: Internet Archive
sites.licence: Per item: only items whose uploader set a Creative Commons licence URL (cc0, public domain mark, by, by-sa). Lending-library and restricted items are skipped.
sites.terms: Public JSON APIs (advancedsearch, metadata). Polite rate, identify the bot. The uploader's licence tag is not verified by the Archive: use the Admin remove tool if a book is wrongly marked.
sites.verified: 2026-11-17: search API returned 4,091 CC-licensed children's texts; metadata API read for one item.

sites.name: Wikimedia Commons
sites.licence: Free licences only by Commons policy (public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA). Licence read per file.
sites.terms: MediaWiki API, no key. Wikimedia asks for a descriptive User-Agent with contact details and low request rates.
sites.verified: Documented public API; not yet run live from this build (the build machine had no direct internet).

sites.name: Book Dash
sites.licence: CC BY 4.0 (stated on every book page)
sites.terms: Books may be freely read, downloaded, printed, translated and shared with credit to Book Dash and the creators. Their e-book download is a 60 MB folder (zip) of PDF and page images, so a reader needs to unpack it.
sites.verified: 2026-11-17: licence and download links read from a book page.

sites.name: African Storybook (Saide)
sites.terms: No public listing or API found. Bulk copying should be agreed with Saide (africanstorybook@saide.org.za) before any collector is built.

sites.name: StoryWeaver (Pratham Books)
sites.licence: Most stories CC BY 4.0, but each story shows its own licence
sites.terms: The terms page could not be read when this list was made. Confirm that bulk download is allowed, and that no login is needed, before building a reader. Best source for Tamil and other Indian-language books.

sites.name: Global Digital Library
sites.licence: Openly licensed (CC BY and similar) per book
sites.terms: Aggregates books from StoryWeaver, Book Dash, African Storybook and others. Check the download and bulk-use terms.

sites.name: Project Gutenberg
sites.licence: Public domain in the USA (not always elsewhere)
sites.terms: Mostly EPUB and text, not PDF, so it does not fit the PDF reader yet. Public-domain status outside the USA needs care.

sites.name: Open Library
sites.licence: Most books are in copyright and only lendable
sites.terms: Not collected directly. Public-domain scans appear through Internet Archive, which is collected with licence checks.

sites.name: FreeKidsBooks.org
sites.licence: Books are shared by their publishers for reading; no open licence is stated per book
sites.terms: Treated as not allowed: redistribution is not granted. Link to it, do not copy from it.

sites.name: Oxford Owl, Raz-Kids, Epic!, Scribd, Amazon free Kindle books
sites.terms: Never downloaded: sign-in or paywall, and the terms forbid copying.
